constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths and only the Progress section of their own plan file. No git state changes (no commit, stash, branch or worktree); never push.

artifactRoots exactly ["target"]; native-parity/capture.test.ts and mcp-stdio.test.ts are excluded and deferred.
Every gate attempt writes a new mktemp log, prints log=<path> and ends with the exit status of the whole gate (CAP-R7-05). No log is overwritten; target/capture-m16/gate-3.log stays as history.
CLI unit tests run with UPDATE_CAPTURE_FIXTURES=0; tracked fixtures unchanged.
Timing tests: up to three attempts, then the case alone; every attempt logged.
Read each owned file fresh before every edit and record git hash-object before and after it; drift is recorded and stops the work, never overwritten.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R7-01: M16 reduced scope; targeted gates only; full verification deferred and NOT yet run.
CAP-R7-04: M16 stays pending until its deliverables, gates and review complete; then every row accepted with the deferral sentence.
CAP-R7-05: new complete log per gate attempt, exit status written after all assertions.

CAP-R7-06: publish only the reviewed, hashed candidate via the integration commit. A preliminary failure restores nothing; a candidate failure or rejection restores from that attempt's own snapshot. Exact status check.

intentionalTradeoffs: Full repository verification is deferred and NOT yet run; it runs after the merge with feat/cad3d-pages, outside this workflow.
status-check.sh lives under target/ (artifact root). Its source of truth is the fenced block in capture-16c-finalize.md, and the review checks that the two are byte-equal.
M16c depends on M16b only through acceptance order (CAP-R7-04 needs M16b accepted before M16 is marked); they share no file except the target artifact root, in disjoint subpaths.
supportedEdgeCases: Timing test flake under machine load: up to three logged attempts, then the case alone, every attempt logged.
Preliminary gate failure: nothing is restored and both live hashes stay unchanged.
Candidate gate failure or review rejection: design and overview restored from that attempt's own mktemp snapshot with matching hashes; M16 stays pending.
Owned-file drift detected by git hash-object: recorded and work stops, never overwritten.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Failures only visible in mise run verify, browser tests, the whole native parity suite or after the merge with feat/cad3d-pages (deferred and NOT yet run).
Re-measuring budgets on another machine; tests that write under tmp/ (native-parity/capture.test.ts, mcp-stdio.test.ts are excluded and deferred).
